Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands - including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank - to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

When someone calls an airline, texts a retailer, or opens their bank's app and talks to a Sierra agent, our systems carry that conversation. Phone calls, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and the chat inside our customers' apps all run through this team.

AI voice, chat, and messaging agents are new and they must operate with global communication networks. Nobody has fully solved how to make the two work together at the speed of a real conversation. We have to solve it for millions of calls, and you will be building the future of how entire industries will operate with AI agents.

Demo: Finding the perfect stay https://sierra.ai/resources/videos/demo-finding-the-perfect-stay

Demo: Flight disruption recovery https://sierra.ai/resources/videos/demo-flight-disruption-recovery

- Multi-modal: Make one conversation work across voice, text, and screen. A customer can start by talking, switch to typing on a crowded train, send a photo of a broken part, and get a link or a form back on screen. The agent remembers everything, whichever way the customer talks and personalizes it. You will build on the frontier here, and decide what it should feel like.

- Make AI voice feel like a real conversation. Every call crosses carriers, telephony networks, and contact centers around the world before it reaches our agent. Making AI agents feel lively and real across global infrastructure is a critical problem to get right for end users.

- Give personal AI agents a safe way in. More people now have their own AI assistants. Today a company can either block them or hand them the user’s full account access. The Personal Agent Protocol https://personalagentprotocol.org/ is an open standard that offers a better option: a safe way for personal agents to work with a company and its Sierra agent. You’ll help build it.

- Build the agent experience inside the app. ChatKit is our library of native iOS, Android, and web components for talking to an agent. It covers voice controls, live waveforms, transcripts, and chat. Customers use it to build an agent experience inside a customer’s flagship app, not like a widget added on top. You decide what those components are and how they behave.

- Get every call to the right agent. You’ll build and own our global telephony stack: SIP, WebRTC, the Sierra Voice Protocol and our integrations with major contact-center platforms. That means millions of calls and messages, and every one of them reaching the right agent.

- Put Sierra on every channel. SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, email, LINE, Messenger and Instagram. You’ll build the tools that let developers launch a new channel on their own, delivering value in hours not weeks.

description:
Cos'è Blox Space ?
Blox Space lavora al centro dell'economia tech,in partnership con un network di oltre 70 realtà attive nel mondo dell'AI, del software, della cybersecurity e delle Freedom Technologies, impegnate nello sviluppo di infrastrutture, prodotti e servizi legati all'economia digitale, alla data protection e al futuro del denaro.
﻿Aiutiamo a connettere i talenti con questo ecosistema, operando come Talent Bridge tra le ambizioni di crescita dei professionisti e le opportunità offerte dal nostro network.
﻿In questo momento stiamo supportando una delle nostre partner companies nella ricerca di un LLM Fine-Tuning Engineer, e se pensi di essere il profilo giusto, ci piacerebbe conoscerti.
Il Ruolo
L'azienda è una startup di cybersecurity italiana che costruisce sistemi di sicurezza autonomi: individuano vulnerabilità sconosciute, prioritizzano il rischio reale e distribuiscono le correzioni senza intervento umano, con un focus sui binari compilati, perché è quello che gira davvero in produzione. È un team early, pre-seed, fondato da ricercatori di sicurezza e accademici di primo piano.
﻿Cerchiamo un LLM Fine-Tuning Engineer che adatti, valuti e metta in produzione modelli linguistici open-weight, ma piegati a un unico scopo: trovare e capire vulnerabilità. Per questo cerchiamo una persona fortemente orientata alla cybersecurity, che non si limiti ad addestrare modelli ma capisca il dominio su cui lavorano. Non è un ruolo di prompt engineering: è l'intero ciclo di post-training, dal design dei dataset al fine tuning, dalla generazione di dati sintetici alla valutazione, fino al deploy in ambienti locali, privati o ristretti.
﻿ Non cerchiamo il curriculum perfetto, cerchiamo la testa giusta. Cerchiamo chi sa trasformare un foundation model in un sistema affidabile e specifico per il compito, sa quando il fine tuning è la strada giusta e quando invece conviene prompting, retrieval, orchestrazione o tooling, e porta con sé una vera sensibilità per il mindset di chi attacca.
﻿ Le responsabilità di un LLM Fine-Tuning Engineer in questo contesto possono spaziare dal fine tuning e dall'adattamento di LLM open-weight per casi d'uso di sicurezza, interni o rivolti al cliente, al confronto tra approcci di post-training (SFT, tecniche parameter-efficient come LoRA e QLoRA, preference tuning come DPO dove serve, full fine tuning quando giustificato), dalla costruzione e pulizia di dataset di qualità e dalla generazione di dati sintetici alla definizione di metodi di valutazione che vanno oltre i benchmark generici, fino all'analisi di regressioni e failure mode e al lavoro con il team di engineering per servire i modelli in ambienti vincolati.
﻿﻿﻿
Le skill che fanno la differenza

•
Esperienza pratica vera nel fine tuning di LLM: in produzione, in ricerca applicata o in contesti sperimentali seri, con più tecniche di post-training alle spalle, idealmente SFT, LoRA e QLoRA.

•
Orientamento forte alla cybersecurity: capisci (o hai una gran voglia di capire a fondo) threat model, bug hunting e la logica di chi attacca. È il dominio su cui i modelli lavorano, e qui fa la differenza tra un buon fine tuning e uno inutile.

•
Dati prima di tutto: sai costruire, curare e mantenere dataset per training e valutazione, e sai generare, filtrare e validare dati sintetici per migliorare il comportamento del modello, non per gonfiare le metriche.

•
Stack solido: Python forte, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, tokenizzazione, preprocessing e training pipeline sono pane quotidiano.

•
Dimestichezza con i vincoli reali: limiti di GPU, trade-off memoria/performance, workflow quantization-aware e ottimizzazione del training.

•
Mentalità da debugging: sai capire perché un modello è migliorato, è regredito, ha fatto overfit o ha fallito, e la valutazione la imposti su quello che conta davvero a livello operativo, non sui punteggi generici.

•
Autonomia a cavallo tra ricerca, dati ed engineering: ti muovi da solo su tutti e tre i fronti.

description:
ABOUT NU

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the Role

As a SOX Specialist in Nubank's SOx Internal Controls team, you will own the ICFR cycle for a defined portfolio of processes, from walkthroughs to audit-ready testing. As a second line function, we challenge process and control owners so that management can sign its SOx 302/404 conclusions with confidence.

This role is built on strong accounting and financial statement skills. You should be able to define materiality and scope of accounts by reading the Group's financial statements, and apply GAAP (mainly IFRS) to design controls that prevent material misstatements on a timely basis. Your accounting and disclosure knowledge is what lets you hold deep discussions with Finance specialists and with the external auditors throughout the audit.

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Owning the ICFR cycle for a defined process portfolio: Risk and Control Matrix (RCM), narratives, walkthroughs, TOD and TOE.

- Linking the risks identified in the RCM directly to the financial statement line item (FSLI).

- Applying Nu's internal methodology and tying Risk → Assertion → Objective → Control → Evidence.

- Determining technologies in scope and deciding when to request SOC reports (ITGC).

- Challenging process and control owners, and treating IPE/EUC in design and testing.

- Executing TOE according to sampling and RoMM, and independently producing audit-ready workpapers.

- Drafting deficiency texts that size impact, magnitude and probability on the financial statements, and tracking remediation with the first line.

- Contributing to cross-functional discussions with IT, Finance, first line and external audit counterparts on your scope.

- Using low-code automation and AI with a risk lens, never as a substitute for professional skepticism.

- Leading a specific pack, process or workstream, sharing what you learn and supporting teammates.

- Contributing to cross-functional discussions with IT, first line and external audit counterparts on your scope.

- Deal with complex and increasingly ambiguous problems that involve several stakeholders, trade-offs between speed and rigor, and a busy calendar of changes and new geographies, with no predefined path to the solution.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

- Education: Degree in Accounting, Economics or Business Administration, around 6 years of experience in similar positions.

- At least one of following experiences: Big 4 integrated audit; public-company Internal Audit with an annual SOX cycle; 2LoD Internal Controls / SOX office; controllership experience.

- Fluent English (written and spoken) to document workpapers and manage stakeholders around the world.

- Independence on scoped projects: you close SOX deliverables with light review, not constant supervision.

- Deep understanding of accounting principles, mainly IFRS (for example, IFRS 9, IFRS 18), and of financial statement disclosure.

- Ability to read the Group's financial statements to define materiality and scope of accounts.

- Ability to explain which assertion a control mitigates and how its failure becomes a misstatement.

- Working knowledge of COSO 2013 and PCAOB standards, including AS 2201.

- Knowledge of AI tools and light-coding programs (Databricks, Cursor, Gemini). Build no-code/low-code AI automations independently and weighs initiatives by ROI, effort and risk.

Sao Paulo, Brazil

Work model

Hybrid

2 days per week at the office.

title: Sales Manager Schools - New Business (gn)
description:
Als Sales Manager Schools - New Business (gn) liegt dein klarer Fokus auf der aktiven Neukundengewinnung bei Schulen und Schulträgern. Du führst vertriebsstarke Verkaufsgespräche und trägst durch den Direktverkauf unserer Angebote maßgeblich dazu bei, dass immer mehr neue Schüler*innen und Lehrkräfte mit sofatutor arbeiten können. Somit unterstützt du aktiv unser Ziel, sofatutor als das führende digitale Lernmedium im Schulbereich zu etablieren und den Markt proaktiv zu erschließen.
📍 remote (innerhalb Deutschlands) | ⏳ 35-40h/Woche
🗓️ Ablauf des Bewerbungsprozesses:

• Erstgespräch per Videocall mit Talent Acquisition Manager (ca. 30min)

• Bearbeitung einer asynchronen Case Study (ca. 90min zu einem Zeitpunkt deiner Wahl)

• Zweitgespräch per Videocall mit Team Lead und einer weiteren Person (ca. 60-90min)

• virtuelles Kennenlernen des Teams (ca. 30min)

Das macht uns aus:
sofatutor ist eine digitale Lernplattform, die über eine Million Schüler*innen, deren Eltern und Lehrkräfte beim Lernen und Lehren unterstützt - mit anschaulichen Videos, interaktiven Übungen, Lernspielen und hilfreichen Arbeitsmaterialien. Unser Ziel ist es, Lernen einfach, effektiv und für alle zugänglich zu gestalten. Dabei treibt uns der Anspruch an, uns nicht mit dem Status quo zufriedenzugeben - wir wollen uns stetig weiterentwickeln, für unsere Nutzer*innen und für uns selbst. Wir lernen voneinander, geben und nehmen aktiv Feedback und wachsen gemeinsam als Team. Unsere Überzeugung, dass digitale Bildung Großes bewegen kann, ist dabei ein zentraler Antrieb. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fühlen wir uns zuhause: Wir denken flexibel, handeln lösungsorientiert und sind offen für den Einsatz moderner Tools wie künstlicher Intelligenz.
Dein Verantwortungsbereich:
Wir glauben daran, dass Schulen ihren Unterricht mit unserem Produkt ganz einfach digital gestalten können. Deswegen wollen wir sofatutor im Schulbereich noch bekannter machen und neue Partnerschaften aufbauen. Dein Job ist es, durch gezielte Akquise neue Schulleitungen und Schulträger zu gewinnen, umfassend zu beraten und ihnen eine für sie passende Lizenz zu verkaufen. Neukundengewinnung sowie Akquisetätigkeit stehen klar im Fokus deiner Rolle. Deine Aufgaben umfassen im Detail:

• Konsequente Durchführung von Outbound-Sales-Aktivitäten (Cold Calling, E-Mail-Akquise etc.) zur aktiven Neukundengewinnung und zur Steigerung des Umsatzes im B2B-Bereich mit Fokus auf Schulen

• Gezielte Ansprache und Qualifizierung von Leads und potenziellen Neukunden

• Bedarfsgerechte Beratung und Verkauf von Lösungen unserer Schulprodukte

• Durchführung von Inbound-Sales-Aktivitäten zur Bearbeitung von Anfragen neuer Interessent*innen

• Erstellung und Verhandlung maßgeschneiderter Angebote für Schulen und Schulträger, um Abschlüsse (Closings) zu erzielen

• Organisation und Durchführung von Demos und Schulungen zum erfolgreichen Onboarding neuer Kund*innen

• Bestandskundenpflege ergänzend zu dem klaren Schwerpunkt auf der Akquise

Das bringst du mit:
Du solltest von unserem Produkt genauso überzeugt sein, wie wir es sind, dir ambitionierte Ziele für die Neukundengewinnung setzen und diese konsequent verfolgen. Du bringst Leidenschaft für den Vertrieb mit und möchtest deine bisherige Erfahrung in diesem Bereich weiter ausbauen. Du passt perfekt zu uns, wenn du Folgendes mitbringst:

• Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundenakquise / im Hunting (idealerweise im Bildungssektor oder ähnlichen B2B-Umfeldern)

• Hohe Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, überzeugende, abschlussorientierte Verkaufsgespräche zu führen

• Fähigkeit, Angebote erfolgreich zu verhandeln und Geschäftsabschlüsse (New Business) zu erzielen

• Erfahrung im Auf- und Ausbau von Kundenbeziehungen und der Sicherstellung von Kundenzufriedenheit

• Leidenschaft für das Thema Bildung und Interesse an der Zusammenarbeit mit Schulen

• Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit

• Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gepaart mit guten Englischkenntnissen
